name: fswd-m2-axios-starter
description: Axios instance and Vite environment variable assignment

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix Axios-Instance-and-Vite-Environment-Variables install && npm --prefix Axios-Instance-and-Vite-Environment-Variables/server install && npm --prefix Axios-Instance-and-Vite-Environment-Variables/client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta "npm run server" "npm run client"
